properties.name: bulk-loader.storage.local-root
properties.description: Root directory used to persist uploaded bulk-loader files.

properties.name: bulk-loader.tus.expiry-hours
properties.description: Number of hours before incomplete TUS uploads expire.

properties.name: bulk-loader.tus.cleanup-interval-ms
properties.description: Cleanup interval in milliseconds for expired TUS uploads.

properties.name: bulk-loader.tus.max-upload-size
properties.description: Maximum allowed upload size in bytes for TUS uploads.

properties.description: Eureka service id for bulk-ingest calls to pos-catalog (load-balanced, #641).

properties.description: Eureka service id for bulk-ingest calls to pos-customer (load-balanced, #641).

properties.name: pos.location.service-id
properties.description: Eureka service id for bulk-ingest calls to pos-location (load-balanced, #641).

properties.name: pos.security.service-id
properties.description: Eureka service id for user and person-link bulk-ingest calls to pos-security-service. Distinct from pos.security.base-url, which is the direct URL used for startup permission registration before discovery is available.

properties.name: pos.shop-manager.service-id
properties.description: Eureka service id for mechanic-skill bulk-ingest calls to pos-shop-manager.

properties.name: pos.inventory.service-id
properties.description: Eureka service id for opening-stock bulk-ingest calls to pos-inventory, and for the storage-location lookups that resolve each row's destination.

properties.description: Base URL of the pos-events/event-receiver API.

properties.name: pos.events.api-secret
properties.description: Shared secret used to authenticate event type registration requests.

properties.description: Base URL for permission registration against pos-security-service.

properties.name: pos.security.permission-registration.enabled
properties.description: Enable startup permission registration with pos-security-service.
